status: completed nested development evaluation and one-time locked external evaluation

task_key_rules.all: remove path prefix after the final slash and pair within benchmark only

cybashbench.exclusion_reason: selected model set has no observed execution commands

nl2bash.exclusion_reason: selected model set has no observed execution commands

selection.selection_rule: threshold maximizes mean direction-adjusted classification utility subject to FSR <= 20%; choose a Pareto method with the largest mean direction-adjusted change across 14 prespecified metrics, tie fewer worse metrics, lower FMR, higher NDCG@5, then simpler method

command_tfidf.selection: highest mean direction-adjusted classification utility across 10 rates/coverage measures subject to macro FSR <= 20%; lower FMR then higher threshold breaks ties

profile_24d.selection: highest mean direction-adjusted classification utility across 10 rates/coverage measures subject to macro FSR <= 20%; lower FMR then higher threshold breaks ties

tensor_4x8x3.selection: highest mean direction-adjusted classification utility across 10 rates/coverage measures subject to macro FSR <= 20%; lower FMR then higher threshold breaks ties

tensor_tucker.selection: highest mean direction-adjusted classification utility across 10 rates/coverage measures subject to macro FSR <= 20%; lower FMR then higher threshold breaks ties

partial_sequence.selection: highest mean direction-adjusted classification utility across 10 rates/coverage measures subject to macro FSR <= 20%; lower FMR then higher threshold breaks ties

learned_fusion.selection: highest mean direction-adjusted classification utility across 10 rates/coverage measures subject to macro FSR <= 20%; lower FMR then higher threshold breaks ties

joint_task_bootstrap.utility: per-task mean of paired direction-adjusted deltas across available prespecified metrics; task resampled within benchmark

multi_metric_summary.interpretation: descriptive point-estimate summary across available prespecified metrics; individual paired intervals remain authoritative

metrics.false_split_guard: external paired 95% CI upper bound for selected method minus command baseline <= +2 percentage points

effectiveness_assessment.interpretation: meets the preregistered external FMR, FSR, ranking and joint-metric criteria

dimensions.pair_labels_use: same versus different benchmark-qualified task only

features.partial_sequence: 0.5 * train-IDF weighted command-name Jaccard + 0.5 * train-IDF weighted ordered command-bigram Jaccard
features.fusion: logistic regression on five trace-pair similarities, fitted to task-only training pairs

model.fit_boundary: vectorizer, IDF, imputation, scaling, Tucker factors and fusion are fitted on development training tasks only
